# Parameters and Filters Source: https://api-platform.com/docs/core/filters/ # Parameters and Filters For documentation on the specific filter implementations available for your persistence layer, please refer to the following pages: - **[Doctrine Filters](../core/doctrine-filters.md)** - **[Elasticsearch Filters](../core/elasticsearch-filters.md)** API Platform provides a generic and powerful system to apply filters, sort criteria, and handle other request parameters. This system is primarily managed through **Parameter attributes** (`#[QueryParameter]` and `#[HeaderParameter]`), which allow for detailed and explicit configuration of how an API consumer can interact with a resource. These parameters can be linked to **Filters**, which are classes that contain the logic for applying criteria to your persistence backend (like Doctrine ORM or MongoDB ODM). You can declare parameters on a resource class to apply them to all operations, or on a specific operation for more granular control. When parameters are enabled, they automatically appear in the Hydra, [OpenAPI](openapi.md) and [GraphQL](graphql.md) documentations.


Watch the Filtering & Searching screencast< > [!WARNING] For maximum flexibility and to ensure future compatibility, it is strongly recommended > to configure your filters via the parameters attribute using `QueryParameter`. The legacy method > using the `ApiFilter` attribute is not recommended. ## Declaring Parameters The recommended way to define parameters is by using Parameter attributes directly on a resource class or on an operation. API Platform provides two main types of Parameter attributes based on their location (matching the OpenAPI `in` configuration): - `ApiPlatform\Metadata\QueryParameter`: For URL query parameters (e.g., `?name=value`). - `ApiPlatform\Metadata\HeaderParameter`: For HTTP headers (e.g., `Custom-Header: value`). ### List of Available Filters When defining a `QueryParameter`, you must specify the filtering logic using the `filter` option. Here is a list of available filters you can use. You can pass the filter class name (recommended) or a new instance: - **`SortFilter`**: For sorting results by a single property. Designed exclusively for use with `QueryParameter`. Supports dot notation for nested/related properties and the `nullsComparison` option. Recommended over `OrderFilter` for new code. - Usage: `new QueryParameter(filter: new SortFilter(), property: 'name')` - **`DateFilter`**: For filtering by date intervals (e.g., `?createdAt[after]=...`). - Usage: `new QueryParameter(filter: DateFilter::class)` - **`ExactFilter`**: For exact value matching. Supports dot notation for nested properties. - Usage: `new QueryParameter(filter: ExactFilter::class)` - **`PartialSearchFilter`**: For partial string matching (SQL `LIKE %...%`). Supports dot notation for nested properties. - Usage: `new QueryParameter(filter: PartialSearchFilter::class)` - **`StartSearchFilter`**: For prefix matching (`LIKE value%`). Supports dot notation for nested properties. See the [Doctrine Filters documentation](doctrine-filters.md#start-search-filter) for case-sensitivity defaults. - Usage: `new QueryParameter(filter: StartSearchFilter::class)` - **`EndSearchFilter`**: For suffix matching (`LIKE %value`). Supports dot notation for nested properties. See the [Doctrine Filters documentation](doctrine-filters.md#end-search-filter) for case-sensitivity defaults. - Usage: `new QueryParameter(filter: EndSearchFilter::class)` - **`WordStartSearchFilter`** (Doctrine ORM/ODM only, no Laravel/Eloquent equivalent): Matches fields containing a word that starts with the value. Supports dot notation for nested properties. See the [Doctrine Filters documentation](doctrine-filters.md#word-start-search-filter) for details. - Usage: `new QueryParameter(filter: WordStartSearchFilter::class)` - **`IriFilter`**: For filtering by IRIs (e.g., relations). Supports dot notation for nested associations. - Usage: `new QueryParameter(filter: IriFilter::class)` - **`ComparisonFilter`**: A decorator that wraps an equality filter (`ExactFilter`, `UuidFilter`) to add `gt`, `gte`, `lt`, `lte`, `ne`, and a native `between` (`[between]=X..Y`) operator. Recommended for numeric comparisons. (`DateFilter` is kept as a drop-in filter — see below; `RangeFilter` is deprecated in its favor.) - Usage: `new QueryParameter(filter: new ComparisonFilter(new ExactFilter()), property: 'price')` - **`FreeTextQueryFilter`**: Applies a filter across multiple properties using a single parameter. - Usage: `new QueryParameter(filter: new FreeTextQueryFilter(new PartialSearchFilter()), properties: ['name', 'description'])` - **`OrFilter`**: A decorator that forces a filter to combine criteria with `OR` instead of `AND`. - Usage: `new QueryParameter(filter: new OrFilter(new ExactFilter()), properties: ['name', 'ean'])` - **`ChainFilter`** (Doctrine ORM/ODM only): Composes several filters on a single parameter key; each wrapped filter self-selects by the shape of the value. content.text:
I have what I need from the docs and vendor code. My design:

- **Resources** (`App\ApiResource`) with `shortName` set to the spec's type names, served by API Platform's JSON:API format.
- **Providers** read through DBAL with no schema changes. A shared query parser enforces the 400 rules.
- **Writes** (POST/PATCH) run through processors that read the raw JSON:API body. This lets me control the 415/409/422 and 402/409/502 rules exactly.
- **Errors** go through one listener that emits JSON:API error documents.

I'll write the resource classes first.

input.content:
<?php

namespace App\ApiResource;

use ApiPlatform\Metadata\ApiResource;
use ApiPlatform\Metadata\Get;
use ApiPlatform\Metadata\GetCollection;
use ApiPlatform\Metadata\QueryParameter;
use App\State\AuthorProvider;

#[ApiResource(
    shortName: 'authors',
    operations: [
        new GetCollection(
            uriTemplate: '/authors',
            provider: AuthorProvider::class,
            parameters: [
                new QueryParameter(key: 'page[number]', schema: ['type' => 'integer', 'minimum' => 1, 'default' => 1], description: 'Page number, from 1.'),
                new QueryParameter(key: 'page[size]', schema: ['type' => 'integer', 'minimum' => 1, 'maximum' => 50, 'default' => 10], description: 'Items per page, from 1 to 50.'),
            ],
        ),
        new Get(
            uriTemplate: '/authors/{id}',
            provider: AuthorProvider::class,
            parameters: [
                new QueryParameter(key: 'include', schema: ['type' => 'string', 'enum' => ['books']], description: 'Related resources to include: books.'),
            ],
        ),
    ],
)]
final class Author
{
    public int $id;

    public ?string $name = null;

    public int $publishedBooks = 0;

    /** @var list<Book> */
    public array $books = [];

    /**
     * @param array{id: int|string, name: ?string, published_books?: int|string} $row
     */
    public static function fromRow(array $row): self
    {
        $author = new self();
        $author->id = (int) $row['id'];
        $author->name = $row['name'];
        $author->publishedBooks = (int) ($row['published_books'] ?? 0);

        return $author;
    }
}

namespace App\Http;

use ApiPlatform\Metadata\Exception\ProblemExceptionInterface;
use App\ApiResource\Purchase;
use Doctrine\DBAL\ArrayParameterType;
use Doctrine\DBAL\Connection;
use Doctrine\DBAL\ParameterType;
use Symfony\Component\EventDispatcher\EventSubscriberInterface;
use Symfony\Component\HttpKernel\Event\RequestEvent;
use Symfony\Component\HttpKernel\KernelEvents;

/**
 * Identifies the customer from the Customer-Id header before any purchase operation runs.
 */
final class CustomerIdentificationListener implements EventSubscriberInterface
{
    public const ATTRIBUTE = '_customer_id';

    public function __construct(private readonly Connection $connection)
    {
    }

    public static function getSubscribedEvents(): array
    {
        // Runs after the router (32) has set the resource class, before anything else.
        return [KernelEvents::REQUEST => ['onRequest', 31]];
    }

    public function onRequest(RequestEvent $event): void
    {
        $request = $event->getRequest();
        if (Purchase::class !== $request->attributes->get('_api_resource_class')) {
            return;
        }

        $customerId = QueryParser::identifier($request->headers->get('Customer-Id'));
        if (null === $customerId || !$this->customerExists($customerId)) {
            throw ApiException::single(401, 'A valid Customer-Id header is required.', ['parameter' => 'Customer-Id']);
        }

        $request->attributes->set(self::ATTRIBUTE, $customerId);
    }

    private function customerExists(int $customerId): bool
    {
        return (bool) $this->connection->fetchOne('SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM customer WHERE id = ?)', [$customerId]);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Repository;

use App\Http\ApiException;
use Doctrine\DBAL\ArrayParameterType;
use Doctrine\DBAL\Connection;
use Doctrine\DBAL\ParameterType;
use Doctrine\DBAL\Query\QueryBuilder;

/**
 * Reads and writes the bookshop tables with SQL; the schema is owned by the database.
 */
final class BookshopRepository
{
    private const BOOK_COLUMNS = 'b.id, b.title, b.author_id, b.price_cents, b.published, b.published_at, b.stock, a.name AS author_name';

    /** Sortable API field => column. */
    private const BOOK_SORT_COLUMNS = ['priceCents' => 'b.price_cents', 'title' => 'b.title', 'publishedAt' => 'b.published_at'];

    public function __construct(private readonly Connection $connection)
    {
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, string|int|bool> $filters
     */
    public function countBooks(array $filters): int
    {
        return (int) $this->publishedBooksQuery($filters)->select('COUNT(*)')->executeQuery()->fetchOne();
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, string|int|bool> $filters
     * @param list<array{0: string, 1: bool}> $sort
     *
     * @return list<array<string, mixed>>
     */
    public function findBooks(array $filters, array $sort, int $offset, int $limit): array
    {
        $qb = $this->publishedBooksQuery($filters)
            ->select(self::BOOK_COLUMNS)
            ->setFirstResult($offset)
            ->setMaxResults($limit);

        foreach ($sort as [$field, $descending]) {
            $qb->addOrderBy(self::BOOK_SORT_COLUMNS[$field], $descending ? 'DESC' : 'ASC');
        }
        $qb->addOrderBy('b.id', 'ASC');

        return $qb->executeQuery()->fetchAllAssociative();
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>|null
     */
    public function findBook(int $id, bool $includeUnpublished = false): ?array
    {
        $row = $this->connection->fetchAssociative(
            sprintf('SELECT %s FROM book b JOIN author a ON a.id = b.author_id WHERE b.id = ?%s', self::BOOK_COLUMNS, $includeUnpublished ? '' : ' AND b.published'),
            [$id],
        );

        return false === $row ? null : $row;
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, int|string> $changes column => new value
     */
    public function updateBook(int $id, array $changes): void
    {
        $this->connection->update('book', $changes, ['id' => $id]);
    }

    public function countAuthors(): int
    {
        return (int) $this->connection->fetchOne('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM author');
    }

    /**
     * @return list<array<string, mixed>>
     */
    public function findAuthors(int $offset, int $limit): array
    {
        return $this->connection->fetchAllAssociative(
            'SELECT a.id, a.name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM book b WHERE b.author_id = a.id AND b.published) AS published_books
             FROM author a ORDER BY a.id LIMIT ? OFFSET ?',
            [$limit, $offset],
            [ParameterType::INTEGER, ParameterType::INTEGER],
        );
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>|null
     */
    public function findAuthor(int $id): ?array
    {
        $row = $this->connection->fetchAssociative(
            'SELECT a.id, a.name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM book b WHERE b.author_id = a.id AND b.published) AS published_books
             FROM author a WHERE a.id = ?',
            [$id],
        );

        return false === $row ? null : $row;
    }

    /**
     * Published books of the given authors, in id order.
     *
     * @param list<int|string> $authorIds
     *
     * @return list<array<string, mixed>>
     */
    public function publishedBooksOf(array $authorIds): array
    {
        if ([] === $authorIds) {
            return [];
        }

        return $this->connection->fetchAllAssociative(
            sprintf('SELECT %s FROM book b JOIN author a ON a.id = b.author_id WHERE b.published AND b.author_id IN (?) ORDER BY b.id', self::BOOK_COLUMNS),
            [$authorIds],
            [ArrayParameterType::INTEGER],
        );
    }

    public function countPurchases(int $customerId): int
    {
        return (int) $this->connection->fetchOne('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM purchase WHERE customer_id = ?', [$customerId]);
    }

    /**
     * @return list<array<string, mixed>>
     */
    public function findPurchases(int $customerId, int $offset, int $limit): array
    {
        $rows = $this->connection->fetchAllAssociative(
            'SELECT id, created_at, total_cents FROM purchase WHERE customer_id = ? ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?',
            [$customerId, $limit, $offset],
            [ParameterType::INTEGER, ParameterType::INTEGER, ParameterType::INTEGER],
        );

        return $this->withLines($rows);
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>|null
     */
    public function findPurchase(int $customerId, int $id): ?array
    {
        $rows = $this->connection->fetchAllAssociative(
            'SELECT id, created_at, total_cents FROM purchase WHERE customer_id = ? AND id = ?',
            [$customerId, $id],
            [ParameterType::INTEGER, ParameterType::INTEGER],
        );

        return $this->withLines($rows)[0] ?? null;
    }

    /**
     * Books sold between two instants (inclusive start, exclusive end), by revenue.
     *
     * @return list<array{title: string, quantity: int, revenueCents: int}>
     */
    public function salesReport(\DateTimeImmutable $from, \DateTimeImmutable $untilExclusive): array
    {
        $rows = $this->connection->fetchAllAssociative(
            'SELECT b.title, SUM(pl.quantity) AS quantity, SUM(pl.quantity * pl.unit_price_cents) AS revenue_cents
             FROM purchase_line pl
             JOIN purchase p ON p.id = pl.purchase_id
             JOIN book b ON b.id = pl.book_id
             WHERE p.created_at >= ? AND p.created_at < ?
             GROUP BY b.id, b.title
             ORDER BY revenue_cents DESC, b.title ASC, b.id ASC',
            [$from->format('Y-m-d H:i:sP'), $untilExclusive->format('Y-m-d H:i:sP')],
        );

        return array_map(static fn (array $row): array => [
            'title' => $row['title'],
            'quantity' => (int) $row['quantity'],
            'revenueCents' => (int) $row['revenue_cents'],
        ], $rows);
    }

    /**
     * Stores a purchase and decrements the stock of its books in one transaction.
     *
     * The books are locked first so that the stock check and the payment see a stable state; the
     * callable receives the total in cents and must throw to abort the purchase.
     *
     * @param list<array{bookId: int, quantity: int}> $lines
     * @param callable(int): void                     $pay
     *
     * @return int the new purchase id
     */
    public function placePurchase(int $customerId, array $lines, callable $pay): int
    {
        return $this->connection->transactional(function (Connection $connection) use ($customerId, $lines, $pay): int {
            $bookIds = array_values(array_unique(array_column($lines, 'bookId')));
            sort($bookIds);

            $books = [];
            foreach ($connection->fetchAllAssociative(
                'SELECT id, price_cents, stock, published FROM book WHERE id IN (?) ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE',
                [$bookIds],
                [ArrayParameterType::INTEGER],
            ) as $row) {
                $books[(int) $row['id']] = [
                    'priceCents' => (int) $row['price_cents'],
                    'stock' => (int) $row['stock'],
                    'published' => self::bool($row['published']),
                ];
            }

            $errors = [];
            foreach ($lines as $index => $line) {
                if (!isset($books[$line['bookId']]) || !$books[$line['bookId']]['published']) {
                    $errors[] = ApiException::error(422, sprintf('Book %d is not available.', $line['bookId']), ['pointer' => sprintf('/data/attributes/lines/%d/bookId', $index)]);
                }
            }
            if ([] !== $errors) {
                throw new ApiException(422, $errors);
            }

            $quantities = [];
            foreach ($lines as $line) {
                $quantities[$line['bookId']] = ($quantities[$line['bookId']] ?? 0) + $line['quantity'];
            }
            foreach ($quantities as $bookId => $quantity) {
                if ($books[$bookId]['stock'] < $quantity) {
                    $errors[] = ApiException::error(409, sprintf('Not enough stock for book %d: %d requested, %d available.', $bookId, $quantity, $books[$bookId]['stock']));
                }
            }
            if ([] !== $errors) {
                throw new ApiException(409, $errors);
            }

            $total = 0;
            foreach ($lines as $line) {
                $total += $line['quantity'] * $books[$line['bookId']]['priceCents'];
            }
            $pay($total);

            $purchaseId = (int) $connection->fetchOne(
                'INSERT INTO purchase (customer_id, total_cents) VALUES (?, ?) RETURNING id',
                [$customerId, $total],
            );
            foreach ($lines as $line) {
                $connection->insert('purchase_line', [
                    'purchase_id' => $purchaseId,
                    'book_id' => $line['bookId'],
                    'quantity' => $line['quantity'],
                    'unit_price_cents' => $books[$line['bookId']]['priceCents'],
                ]);
            }
            foreach ($quantities as $bookId => $quantity) {
                $connection->executeStatement('UPDATE book SET stock = stock - ? WHERE id = ?', [$quantity, $bookId]);
            }

            return $purchaseId;
        });
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, string|int|bool> $filters
     */
    private function publishedBooksQuery(array $filters): QueryBuilder
    {
        $qb = $this->connection->createQueryBuilder()
            ->from('book', 'b')
            ->innerJoin('b', 'author', 'a', 'a.id = b.author_id')
            ->where('b.published = TRUE');

        if (isset($filters['title'])) {
            $qb->andWhere('b.title ILIKE :title')
                ->setParameter('title', '%'.addcslashes((string) $filters['title'], '%_\\').'%');
        }
        if (isset($filters['author'])) {
            $qb->andWhere('a.name = :author')->setParameter('author', $filters['author']);
        }
        if (isset($filters['minPrice'])) {
            $qb->andWhere('b.price_cents >= :minPrice')->setParameter('minPrice', $filters['minPrice'], ParameterType::INTEGER);
        }
        if (isset($filters['maxPrice'])) {
            $qb->andWhere('b.price_cents <= :maxPrice')->setParameter('maxPrice', $filters['maxPrice'], ParameterType::INTEGER);
        }
        if (isset($filters['publishedAfter'])) {
            $qb->andWhere('b.published_at >= :publishedAfter')->setParameter('publishedAfter', $filters['publishedAfter']);
        }
        if (isset($filters['publishedBefore'])) {
            $qb->andWhere('b.published_at <= :publishedBefore')->setParameter('publishedBefore', $filters['publishedBefore']);
        }
        if (array_key_exists('inStock', $filters)) {
            $qb->andWhere($filters['inStock'] ? 'b.stock > 0' : 'b.stock = 0');
        }

        return $qb;
    }

    /**
     * @param list<array<string, mixed>> $purchases
     *
     * @return list<array<string, mixed>>
     */
    private function withLines(array $purchases): array
    {
        if ([] === $purchases) {
            return [];
        }

        $lines = [];
        foreach ($this->connection->fetchAllAssociative(
            'SELECT pl.purchase_id, pl.book_id, b.title, pl.quantity, pl.unit_price_cents
             FROM purchase_line pl JOIN book b ON b.id = pl.book_id
             WHERE pl.purchase_id IN (?) ORDER BY pl.id',
            [array_column($purchases, 'id')],
            [ArrayParameterType::INTEGER],
        ) as $row) {
            $lines[(int) $row['purchase_id']][] = [
                'bookId' => (int) $row['book_id'],
                'title' => $row['title'],
                'quantity' => (int) $row['quantity'],
                'unitPriceCents' => (int) $row['unit_price_cents'],
            ];
        }

        return array_map(
            static fn (array $purchase): array => $purchase + ['lines' => $lines[(int) $purchase['id']] ?? []],
            $purchases,
        );
    }

    /**
     * PDO returns PostgreSQL booleans as 't'/'f' strings or as bools, depending on the driver.
     */
    public static function bool(mixed $value): bool
    {
        return true === $value || 't' === $value || '1' === $value || 1 === $value;
    }
}

     * @param list<array{0: string, 1: bool}> $sort
     *
     * @return list<array<string, mixed>>
     */
    public function findBooks(array $filters, array $sort, int $offset, int $limit): array
    {
        $qb = $this->publishedBooksQuery($filters)
            ->select(self::BOOK_COLUMNS)
            ->setFirstResult($offset)
            ->setMaxResults($limit);

        foreach ($sort as [$field, $descending]) {
            $qb->addOrderBy(self::BOOK_SORT_COLUMNS[$field], $descending ? 'DESC' : 'ASC');
        }
        $qb->addOrderBy('b.id', 'ASC');

        return $qb->executeQuery()->fetchAllAssociative();
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>|null
     */
    public function findBook(int $id, bool $includeUnpublished = false): ?array
    {
        $row = $this->connection->fetchAssociative(
            sprintf('SELECT %s FROM book b JOIN author a ON a.id = b.author_id WHERE b.id = ?%s', self::BOOK_COLUMNS, $includeUnpublished ? '' : ' AND b.published'),
            [$id],
        );

        return false === $row ? null : $row;
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, int|string> $changes column => new value
     */
    public function updateBook(int $id, array $changes): void
    {
        $this->connection->update('book', $changes, ['id' => $id]);
    }

    public function countAuthors(): int
    {
        return (int) $this->connection->fetchOne('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM author');
    }

    /**
     * @return list<array<string, mixed>>
     */
    public function findAuthors(int $offset, int $limit): array
    {
        return $this->connection->fetchAllAssociative(
            'SELECT a.id, a.name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM book b WHERE b.author_id = a.id AND b.published) AS published_books
             FROM author a ORDER BY a.id LIMIT ? OFFSET ?',
            [$limit, $offset],
            [ParameterType::INTEGER, ParameterType::INTEGER],
        );
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>|null
     */
    public function findAuthor(int $id): ?array
    {
        $row = $this->connection->fetchAssociative(
            'SELECT a.id, a.name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM book b WHERE b.author_id = a.id AND b.published) AS published_books
             FROM author a WHERE a.id = ?',
            [$id],
        );

        return false === $row ? null : $row;
    }

    /**
     * Published books of the given authors, in id order.
     *
     * @param list<int|string> $authorIds
     *
     * @return list<array<string, mixed>>
     */
    public function publishedBooksOf(array $authorIds): array
    {
        if ([] === $authorIds) {
            return [];
        }

        return $this->connection->fetchAllAssociative(
            sprintf('SELECT %s FROM book b JOIN author a ON a.id = b.author_id WHERE b.published AND b.author_id IN (?) ORDER BY b.id', self::BOOK_COLUMNS),
            [$authorIds],
            [ArrayParameterType::INTEGER],
        );
    }

    public function countPurchases(int $customerId): int
    {
        return (int) $this->connection->fetchOne('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM purchase WHERE customer_id = ?', [$customerId]);
    }

    /**
     * @return list<array<string, mixed>>
     */
    public function findPurchases(int $customerId, int $offset, int $limit): array
    {
        $rows = $this->connection->fetchAllAssociative(
            'SELECT id, created_at, total_cents FROM purchase WHERE customer_id = ? ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?',
            [$customerId, $limit, $offset],
            [ParameterType::INTEGER, ParameterType::INTEGER, ParameterType::INTEGER],
        );

        return $this->withLines($rows);
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>|null
     */
    public function findPurchase(int $customerId, int $id): ?array
    {
        $rows = $this->connection->fetchAllAssociative(
            'SELECT id, created_at, total_cents FROM purchase WHERE customer_id = ? AND id = ?',
            [$customerId, $id],
            [ParameterType::INTEGER, ParameterType::INTEGER],
        );

        return $this->withLines($rows)[0] ?? null;
    }

    /**
     * Books sold between two instants (inclusive start, exclusive end), by revenue.
     *
     * @return list<array{title: string, quantity: int, revenueCents: int}>
     */
    public function salesReport(\DateTimeImmutable $from, \DateTimeImmutable $untilExclusive): array
    {
        $rows = $this->connection->fetchAllAssociative(
            'SELECT b.title, SUM(pl.quantity) AS quantity, SUM(pl.quantity * pl.unit_price_cents) AS revenue_cents
             FROM purchase_line pl
             JOIN purchase p ON p.id = pl.purchase_id
             JOIN book b ON b.id = pl.book_id
             WHERE p.created_at >= ? AND p.created_at < ?
             GROUP BY b.id, b.title
             ORDER BY revenue_cents DESC, b.title ASC, b.id ASC',
            [$from->format('Y-m-d H:i:sP'), $untilExclusive->format('Y-m-d H:i:sP')],
        );

        return array_map(static fn (array $row): array => [
            'title' => $row['title'],
            'quantity' => (int) $row['quantity'],
            'revenueCents' => (int) $row['revenue_cents'],
        ], $rows);
    }

    /**
     * Stores a purchase and decrements the stock of its books in one transaction.
     *
     * The books are locked first so that the stock check and the payment see a stable state; the
     * callable receives the total in cents and must throw to abort the purchase.
     *
     * @param list<array{bookId: int, quantity: int}> $lines
     * @param callable(int): void                     $pay
     *
     * @return int the new purchase id
     */
    public function placePurchase(int $customerId, array $lines, callable $pay): int
    {
        return $this->connection->transactional(function (Connection $connection) use ($customerId, $lines, $pay): int {
            $bookIds = array_values(array_unique(array_column($lines, 'bookId')));
            sort($bookIds);

            $books = [];
            foreach ($connection->fetchAllAssociative(
                'SELECT id, price_cents, stock, published FROM book WHERE id IN (?) ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE',
                [$bookIds],
                [ArrayParameterType::INTEGER],
            ) as $row) {
                $books[(int) $row['id']] = [
                    'priceCents' => (int) $row['price_cents'],
                    'stock' => (int) $row['stock'],
                    'published' => self::bool($row['published']),
                ];
            }

            $errors = [];
            foreach ($lines as $index => $line) {
                if (!isset($books[$line['bookId']]) || !$books[$line['bookId']]['published']) {
                    $errors[] = ApiException::error(422, sprintf('Book %d is not available.', $line['bookId']), ['pointer' => sprintf('/data/attributes/lines/%d/bookId', $index)]);
                }
            }
            if ([] !== $errors) {
                throw new ApiException(422, $errors);
            }

            $quantities = [];
            foreach ($lines as $line) {
                $quantities[$line['bookId']] = ($quantities[$line['bookId']] ?? 0) + $line['quantity'];
            }
            foreach ($quantities as $bookId => $quantity) {
                if ($books[$bookId]['stock'] < $quantity) {
                    $errors[] = ApiException::error(409, sprintf('Not enough stock for book %d: %d requested, %d available.', $bookId, $quantity, $books[$bookId]['stock']));
                }
            }
            if ([] !== $errors) {
                throw new ApiException(409, $errors);
            }

            $total = 0;
            foreach ($lines as $line) {
                $total += $line['quantity'] * $books[$line['bookId']]['priceCents'];
            }
            $pay($total);

            $purchaseId = (int) $connection->fetchOne(
                'INSERT INTO purchase (customer_id, total_cents) VALUES (?, ?) RETURNING id',
                [$customerId, $total],
            );
            foreach ($lines as $line) {
                $connection->insert('purchase_line', [
                    'purchase_id' => $purchaseId,
                    'book_id' => $line['bookId'],
                    'quantity' => $line['quantity'],
                    'unit_price_cents' => $books[$line['bookId']]['priceCents'],
                ]);
            }
            foreach ($quantities as $bookId => $quantity) {
                $connection->executeStatement('UPDATE book SET stock = stock - ? WHERE id = ?', [$quantity, $bookId]);
            }

            return $purchaseId;
        });
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, string|int|bool> $filters
     */
    private function publishedBooksQuery(array $filters): QueryBuilder
    {
        $qb = $this->connection->createQueryBuilder()
            ->from('book', 'b')
            ->innerJoin('b', 'author', 'a', 'a.id = b.author_id')
            ->where('b.published = TRUE');

        if (isset($filters['title'])) {
            $qb->andWhere('b.title ILIKE :title')
                ->setParameter('title', '%'.addcslashes((string) $filters['title'], '%_\\').'%');
        }
        if (isset($filters['author'])) {
            $qb->andWhere('a.name = :author')->setParameter('author', $filters['author']);
        }
        if (isset($filters['minPrice'])) {
            $qb->andWhere('b.price_cents >= :minPrice')->setParameter('minPrice', $filters['minPrice'], ParameterType::INTEGER);
        }
        if (isset($filters['maxPrice'])) {
            $qb->andWhere('b.price_cents <= :maxPrice')->setParameter('maxPrice', $filters['maxPrice'], ParameterType::INTEGER);
        }
        if (isset($filters['publishedAfter'])) {
            $qb->andWhere('b.published_at >= :publishedAfter')->setParameter('publishedAfter', $filters['publishedAfter']);
        }
        if (isset($filters['publishedBefore'])) {
            $qb->andWhere('b.published_at <= :publishedBefore')->setParameter('publishedBefore', $filters['publishedBefore']);
        }
        if (array_key_exists('inStock', $filters)) {
            $qb->andWhere($filters['inStock'] ? 'b.stock > 0' : 'b.stock = 0');
        }

        return $qb;
    }

    /**
     * @param list<array<string, mixed>> $purchases
     *
     * @return list<array<string, mixed>>
     */
    private function withLines(array $purchases): array
    {
        if ([] === $purchases) {
            return [];
        }

        $lines = [];
        foreach ($this->connection->fetchAllAssociative(
            'SELECT pl.purchase_id, pl.book_id, b.title, pl.quantity, pl.unit_price_cents
             FROM purchase_line pl JOIN book b ON b.id = pl.book_id
             WHERE pl.purchase_id IN (?) ORDER BY pl.id',
            [array_column($purchases, 'id')],
            [ArrayParameterType::INTEGER],
        ) as $row) {
            $lines[(int) $row['purchase_id']][] = [
                'bookId' => (int) $row['book_id'],
                'title' => $row['title'],
                'quantity' => (int) $row['quantity'],
                'unitPriceCents' => (int) $row['unit_price_cents'],
            ];
        }

        return array_map(
            static fn (array $purchase): array => $purchase + ['lines' => $lines[(int) $purchase['id']] ?? []],
            $purchases,
        );
    }

    /**
     * PDO returns PostgreSQL booleans as 't'/'f' strings or as bools, depending on the driver.
     */
    public static function bool(mixed $value): bool
    {
        return true === $value || 't' === $value || '1' === $value || 1 === $value;
    }
}

/**
 * Client of the external payment service.
 */
final class PaymentGateway
{
    private const URL = 'http://127.0.0.1:18090/payments';

    public function __construct(private readonly HttpClientInterface $httpClient)
    {
    }

    /**
     * @return bool true when the payment is accepted, false when it is declined
     *
     * @throws PaymentUnavailableException when the service is unreachable or answers anything else
     */
    public function charge(int $customerId, int $amountCents): bool
    {
        try {
            $response = $this->httpClient->request('POST', self::URL, [
                'json' => ['customerId' => $customerId, 'amountCents' => $amountCents],
                'timeout' => 5,
                'max_duration' => 10,
            ]);
            $status = $response->getStatusCode();
            $body = $response->toArray(false);
        } catch (\Throwable $exception) {
            throw new PaymentUnavailableException('The payment service is unavailable.', 0, $exception);
        }

        $answer = is_array($body) ? ($body['status'] ?? null) : null;
        if ('accepted' === $answer && $status >= 200 && $status < 300) {
            return true;
        }
        if ('declined' === $answer && $status < 500) {
            return false;
        }

        throw new PaymentUnavailableException(sprintf('Unexpected answer from the payment service (HTTP %d).', $status));
    }
}

use App\Payment\PaymentUnavailableException;
use App\Repository\BookshopRepository;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\RequestStack;

/**
 * Buys books: validates the lines, reserves the stock, takes the payment and stores the purchase.
 *
 * @implements ProcessorInterface<Purchase, Purchase>
 */
final class PurchasePostProcessor implements ProcessorInterface
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly BookshopRepository $repository,
        private readonly PaymentGateway $payments,
        private readonly RequestStack $requestStack,
    ) {
    }

    public function process(mixed $data, Operation $operation, array $uriVariables = [], array $context = []): Purchase
    {
        $request = $this->requestStack->getCurrentRequest();
        $customerId = (int) $request->attributes->get(CustomerIdentificationListener::ATTRIBUTE);

        $attributes = JsonApiBody::data($request, 'purchases')['attributes'] ?? [];
        $lines = $this->validateLines(is_array($attributes) ? ($attributes['lines'] ?? null) : null);

        $purchaseId = $this->repository->placePurchase($customerId, $lines, function (int $amountCents) use ($customerId): void {
            try {
                $accepted = $this->payments->charge($customerId, $amountCents);
            } catch (PaymentUnavailableException) {
                throw ApiException::single(502, 'The payment service is unavailable.');
            }

            if (!$accepted) {
                throw ApiException::single(402, 'The payment was declined.');
            }
        });

        return Purchase::fromRow($this->repository->findPurchase($customerId, $purchaseId));
    }

    /**
     * @return list<array{bookId: int, quantity: int}>
     */
    private function validateLines(mixed $lines): array
    {
        if (!is_array($lines) || !array_is_list($lines) || [] === $lines) {
            throw ApiException::single(422, 'The lines must be a non-empty list.', ['pointer' => '/data/attributes/lines']);
        }

        $errors = [];
        $valid = [];
        foreach ($lines as $index => $line) {
            $pointer = sprintf('/data/attributes/lines/%d', $index);
            if (!is_array($line)) {
                $errors[] = ApiException::error(422, 'Each line must be an object.', ['pointer' => $pointer]);
                continue;
            }

            $bookId = $line['bookId'] ?? null;
            $quantity = $line['quantity'] ?? null;
            if (!is_int($bookId) || $bookId < 1) {
                $errors[] = ApiException::error(422, 'The bookId must be an integer.', ['pointer' => $pointer.'/bookId']);
            }
            if (!is_int($quantity) || $quantity < 1) {
                $errors[] = ApiException::error(422, 'The quantity must be an integer of at least 1.', ['pointer' => $pointer.'/quantity']);
            }
            if (is_int($bookId) && is_int($quantity) && $bookId >= 1 && $quantity >= 1) {
                $valid[] = ['bookId' => $bookId, 'quantity' => $quantity];
            }
        }

        if ([] !== $errors) {
            throw new ApiException(422, $errors);
        }

        return $valid;
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Controller;

use App\Http\ApiException;
use App\Http\QueryParser;
use App\Repository\BookshopRepository;
use Symfony\Bundle\FrameworkBundle\Controller\AbstractController;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Request;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response;
use Symfony\Component\Routing\Attribute\Route;

final class SalesReportController extends AbstractController
{
    public function __construct(private readonly BookshopRepository $repository)
    {
    }

    /**
     * Public CSV report of the books sold between two days (UTC, both bounds included).
     */
    #[Route('/reports/sales', name: 'sales_report', methods: ['GET'])]
    public function __invoke(Request $request): Response
    {
        $from = $this->day($request, 'from');
        $to = $this->day($request, 'to');
        if ($from > $to) {
            throw ApiException::single(400, 'The "from" date must not be after the "to" date.', ['parameter' => 'from']);
        }

        $lines = ['title,quantity,revenueCents'];
        foreach ($this->repository->salesReport($from, $to->modify('+1 day')) as $row) {
            $lines[] = implode(',', [self::csvField($row['title']), $row['quantity'], $row['revenueCents']]);
        }

        return new Response(
            implode("\r\n", $lines)."\r\n",
            Response::HTTP_OK,
            [
                'Content-Type' => 'text/csv',
                'Content-Disposition' => sprintf('attachment; filename="sales-%s-%s.csv"', $from->format('Y-m-d'), $to->format('Y-m-d')),
            ],
        );
    }

    private function day(Request $request, string $parameter): \DateTimeImmutable
    {
        $value = $request->query->get($parameter);
        if (!is_string($value) || null === ($day = QueryParser::date($value))) {
            throw ApiException::single(400, sprintf('The "%s" parameter is required and must be a date (YYYY-MM-DD).', $parameter), ['parameter' => $parameter]);
        }

        return $day;
    }

    /**
     * RFC 4180: a field is quoted only when it contains a comma, a double quote or a line break.
     */
    private static function csvField(string $value): string
    {
        return 1 === preg_match('/[",\r\n]/', $value) ? '"'.str_replace('"', '""', $value).'"' : $value;
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Serializer;

use ApiPlatform\State\Pagination\PaginatorInterface;
use Symfony\Component\DependencyInjection\Attribute\AutowireDecorated;
use Symfony\Component\DependencyInjection\Attribute\AsDecorator;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\RequestStack;
use Symfony\Component\Serializer\Normalizer\NormalizerInterface;

/**
 * Rewrites the JSON:API pagination links of a collection to use page[number] and page[size],
 * keeping every other query parameter (filters, sort, include) of the request.
 */
#[AsDecorator(decorates: 'api_platform.jsonapi.normalizer.collection')]
final class CollectionLinksNormalizer implements NormalizerInterface
{
    public function __construct(
        #[AutowireDecorated]
        private readonly NormalizerInterface $inner,
        private readonly RequestStack $requestStack,
    ) {
    }

    public function normalize(mixed $data, ?string $format = null, array $context = []): mixed
    {
        $normalized = $this->inner->normalize($data, $format, $context);
        $request = $this->requestStack->getCurrentRequest();
        if (!$data instanceof PaginatorInterface || !is_array($normalized) || null === $request) {
            return $normalized;
        }

        $size = (int) $data->getItemsPerPage();
        $current = (int) $data->getCurrentPage();
        $last = (int) $data->getLastPage();
        $query = $request->query->all();

        $link = static fn (int $page): string => $request->getPathInfo().'?'.http_build_query(
            array_replace($query, ['page' => ['number' => $page, 'size' => $size]]),
            '',
            '&',
            \PHP_QUERY_RFC3986,
        );

        $links = [
            'self' => $link($current),
            'first' => $link(1),
            'last' => $link($last),
        ];
        if ($current > 1) {
            $links['prev'] = $link($current - 1);
        }
        if ($current < $last) {
            $links['next'] = $link($current + 1);
        }
        $normalized['links'] = $links;

        return $normalized;
    }

    public function supportsNormalization(mixed $data, ?string $format = null, array $context = []): bool
    {
        return $this->inner->supportsNormalization($data, $format, $context);
    }

    public function getSupportedTypes(?string $format): array
    {
        return $this->inner->getSupportedTypes($format);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http;

use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Request;

/**
 * Validates the JSON:API query parameters (include, sort, page, filter) of a request.
 *
 * Any malformed or unknown value answers 400 naming the offending parameter.
 */
final class QueryParser
{
    private const DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE = 10;
    private const MAX_PAGE_SIZE = 50;
    private const MAX_INT4 = 2147483647;
    private const MIN_INT4 = -2147483648;

    /**
     * @param list<string>                                $sortable   sortable field names
     * @param list<string>                                $includable include paths allowed
     * @param array<string, 'string'|'int'|'date'|'bool'> $filters    filter name and value type
     */
    public function parseList(Request $request, array $sortable, array $includable, array $filters): ListQuery
    {
        $this->parseInclude($request, $includable);
        [$page, $size] = $this->parsePage($request);

        return new ListQuery($page, $size, $this->parseSort($request, $sortable), $this->parseFilters($request, $filters));
    }

    /**
     * @param list<string> $includable
     */
    public function parseInclude(Request $request, array $includable): void
    {
        $include = $request->query->all()['include'] ?? null;
        if (null === $include) {
            return;
        }
        if (!is_string($include)) {
            throw ApiException::single(400, 'The include parameter must be a comma-separated list of paths.', ['parameter' => 'include']);
        }

        foreach (explode(',', $include) as $path) {
            if (!in_array($path, $includable, true)) {
                throw ApiException::single(400, sprintf('Unknown include path "%s".', $path), ['parameter' => 'include']);
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Returns a positive integer id that fits the database integer type, or null for anything else.
     */
    public static function identifier(mixed $raw): ?int
    {
        if (!is_string($raw) || 1 !== preg_match('/^[1-9][0-9]{0,9}$/', $raw)) {
            return null;
        }
        $id = (int) $raw;

        return $id <= self::MAX_INT4 ? $id : null;
    }

    /**
     * Parses a YYYY-MM-DD calendar date, or returns null.
     */
    public static function date(string $value): ?\DateTimeImmutable
    {
        $date = \DateTimeImmutable::createFromFormat('!Y-m-d', $value, new \DateTimeZone('UTC'));

        return false !== $date && $date->format('Y-m-d') === $value ? $date : null;
    }

    /**
     * @return array{0: int, 1: int}
     */
    private function parsePage(Request $request): array
    {
        $page = $request->query->all()['page'] ?? null;
        if (null === $page) {
            return [1, self::DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE];
        }
        if (!is_array($page)) {
            throw ApiException::single(400, 'The page parameter must be an object with "number" and "size".', ['parameter' => 'page']);
        }

        $number = $page['number'] ?? '1';
        $size = $page['size'] ?? (string) self::DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE;

        if (!is_string($number) || 1 !== preg_match('/^[1-9][0-9]{0,8}$/', $number)) {
            throw ApiException::single(400, 'The page number must be an integer from 1.', ['parameter' => 'page[number]']);
        }
        if (!is_string($size) || 1 !== preg_match('/^[0-9]+$/', $size) || (int) $size < 1 || (int) $size > self::MAX_PAGE_SIZE) {
            throw ApiException::single(400, sprintf('The page size must be an integer from 1 to %d.', self::MAX_PAGE_SIZE), ['parameter' => 'page[size]']);
        }

        return [(int) $number, (int) $size];
    }

    /**
     * @param list<string> $sortable
     *
     * @return list<array{0: string, 1: bool}>
     */
    private function parseSort(Request $request, array $sortable): array
    {
        $sort = $request->query->all()['sort'] ?? null;
        if (null === $sort) {
            return [];
        }
        if (!is_string($sort)) {
            throw ApiException::single(400, 'The sort parameter must be a comma-separated list of fields.', ['parameter' => 'sort']);
        }

        $fields = [];
        foreach (explode(',', $sort) as $item) {
            $descending = str_starts_with($item, '-');
            $field = $descending ? substr($item, 1) : $item;
            if (!in_array($field, $sortable, true)) {
                throw ApiException::single(400, sprintf('Unknown sort field "%s".', $field), ['parameter' => 'sort']);
            }
            $fields[] = [$field, $descending];
        }

        return $fields;
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, 'string'|'int'|'date'|'bool'> $filters
     *
     * @return array<string, string|int|bool>
     */
    private function parseFilters(Request $request, array $filters): array
    {
        $raw = $request->query->all()['filter'] ?? null;
        if (null === $raw) {
            return [];
        }
        if (!is_array($raw)) {
            throw ApiException::single(400, 'The filter parameter must be an object.', ['parameter' => 'filter']);
        }

        $parsed = [];
        foreach ($filters as $name => $type) {
            if (!array_key_exists($name, $raw)) {
                continue;
            }
            $parameter = sprintf('filter[%s]', $name);
            $value = $raw[$name];
            if (!is_string($value)) {
                throw ApiException::single(400, sprintf('The value of %s must be a single value.', $parameter), ['parameter' => $parameter]);
            }

            $parsed[$name] = match ($type) {
                'string' => $value,
                'int' => $this->int($value, $parameter),
                'date' => self::date($value)?->format('Y-m-d') ?? throw ApiException::single(400, sprintf('%s must be a date (YYYY-MM-DD).', $parameter), ['parameter' => $parameter]),
                'bool' => match ($value) {
                    'true' => true,
                    'false' => false,
                    default => throw ApiException::single(400, sprintf('%s must be true or false.', $parameter), ['parameter' => $parameter]),
                },
            };
        }

        return $parsed;
    }

    private function int(string $value, string $parameter): int
    {
        if (1 !== preg_match('/^-?[0-9]{1,10}$/', $value) || (int) $value > self::MAX_INT4 || (int) $value < self::MIN_INT4) {
            throw ApiException::single(400, sprintf('%s must be an integer.', $parameter), ['parameter' => $parameter]);
        }

        return (int) $value;
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Controller;

use App\Http\ApiException;
use App\Http\QueryParser;
use App\Repository\BookshopRepository;
use Symfony\Bundle\FrameworkBundle\Controller\AbstractController;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Request;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response;
use Symfony\Component\Routing\Attribute\Route;

final class SalesReportController extends AbstractController
{
    public function __construct(private readonly BookshopRepository $repository)
    {
    }

    /**
     * Public CSV report of the books sold between two days (UTC, both bounds included).
     */
    #[Route('/reports/sales', name: 'sales_report', methods: ['GET'])]
    public function __invoke(Request $request): Response
    {
        $from = $this->day($request, 'from');
        $to = $this->day($request, 'to');
        if ($from > $to) {
            throw ApiException::single(400, 'The "from" date must not be after the "to" date.', ['parameter' => 'from']);
        }

        $lines = ['title,quantity,revenueCents'];
        foreach ($this->repository->salesReport($from, $to->modify('+1 day')) as $row) {
            $lines[] = implode(',', [self::csvField($row['title']), $row['quantity'], $row['revenueCents']]);
        }

        return new Response(
            implode("\r\n", $lines)."\r\n",
            Response::HTTP_OK,
            [
                'Content-Type' => 'text/csv',
                'Content-Disposition' => sprintf('attachment; filename="sales-%s-%s.csv"', $from->format('Y-m-d'), $to->format('Y-m-d')),
            ],
        );
    }

    private function day(Request $request, string $parameter): \DateTimeImmutable
    {
        $value = $request->query->get($parameter);
        if (!is_string($value) || null === ($day = QueryParser::date($value))) {
            throw ApiException::single(400, sprintf('The "%s" parameter is required and must be a date (YYYY-MM-DD).', $parameter), ['parameter' => $parameter]);
        }

        return $day;
    }

    /**
     * RFC 4180: a field is quoted only when it contains a comma, a double quote or a line break.
     */
    private static function csvField(string $value): string
    {
        return 1 === preg_match('/[",\r\n]/', $value) ? '"'.str_replace('"', '""', $value).'"' : $value;
    }
}

content.text: API Platform hands errors to Symfony's error listener, which renders them via its own error resource and picks the wrong format. The cleaner fix is to render every exception on this API as a JSON:API document and stop propagation so that path never runs. I'll rewrite the listener that way and fix the decorator's normalizer wiring.

<?php

namespace App\Http;

use Symfony\Component\EventDispatcher\EventSubscriberInterface;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response;
use Symfony\Component\HttpKernel\Event\ExceptionEvent;
use Symfony\Component\HttpKernel\Exception\HttpExceptionInterface;
use Symfony\Component\HttpKernel\KernelEvents;

/**
 * Answers every error as a JSON:API error document.
 *
 * Runs before the framework and API Platform error handling, which would otherwise pick their own format.
 */
final class ApiExceptionListener implements EventSubscriberInterface
{
    public static function getSubscribedEvents(): array
    {
        return [KernelEvents::EXCEPTION => ['onException', 256]];
    }

    public function onException(ExceptionEvent $event): void
    {
        $exception = $event->getThrowable();
        $headers = [];

        if ($exception instanceof ApiException) {
            $status = $exception->status;
            $errors = $exception->errors;
        } else {
            $status = $exception instanceof HttpExceptionInterface ? $exception->getStatusCode() : Response::HTTP_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR;
            $detail = $status < 500 ? ($exception->getMessage() ?: Response::$statusTexts[$status] ?? 'Error') : 'An internal error occurred.';
            $errors = [ApiException::error($status, $detail)];
            if ($exception instanceof HttpExceptionInterface) {
                $headers = $exception->getHeaders();
            }
        }

        $event->setResponse(new Response(
            json_encode(['errors' => $errors], JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES),
            $status,
            $headers + ['Content-Type' => 'application/vnd.api+json'],
        ));
        $event->stopPropagation();
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Serializer;

use ApiPlatform\State\Pagination\PaginatorInterface;
use Symfony\Component\DependencyInjection\Attribute\AsDecorator;
use Symfony\Component\DependencyInjection\Attribute\AutowireDecorated;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\RequestStack;
use Symfony\Component\Serializer\Normalizer\NormalizerAwareInterface;
use Symfony\Component\Serializer\Normalizer\NormalizerInterface;

/**
 * Rewrites the JSON:API pagination links of a collection to use page[number] and page[size],
 * keeping every other query parameter (filters, sort, include) of the request.
 */
#[AsDecorator(decorates: 'api_platform.jsonapi.normalizer.collection')]
final class CollectionLinksNormalizer implements NormalizerInterface, NormalizerAwareInterface
{
    public function __construct(
        #[AutowireDecorated]
        private readonly NormalizerInterface $inner,
        private readonly RequestStack $requestStack,
    ) {
    }

    public function normalize(mixed $data, ?string $format = null, array $context = []): \ArrayObject|array|string|int|float|bool|null
    {
        $normalized = $this->inner->normalize($data, $format, $context);
        $request = $this->requestStack->getCurrentRequest();
        if (!$data instanceof PaginatorInterface || !is_array($normalized) || null === $request) {
            return $normalized;
        }

        $size = (int) $data->getItemsPerPage();
        $current = (int) $data->getCurrentPage();
        $last = (int) $data->getLastPage();
        $query = $request->query->all();

        $link = static fn (int $page): string => $request->getPathInfo().'?'.http_build_query(
            array_replace($query, ['page' => ['number' => $page, 'size' => $size]]),
            '',
            '&',
            \PHP_QUERY_RFC3986,
        );

        $links = [
            'self' => $link($current),
            'first' => $link(1),
            'last' => $link($last),
        ];
        if ($current > 1) {
            $links['prev'] = $link($current - 1);
        }
        if ($current < $last) {
            $links['next'] = $link($current + 1);
        }
        $normalized['links'] = $links;

        return $normalized;
    }

    public function setNormalizer(NormalizerInterface $normalizer): void
    {
        if ($this->inner instanceof NormalizerAwareInterface) {
            $this->inner->setNormalizer($normalizer);
        }
    }

    public function supportsNormalization(mixed $data, ?string $format = null, array $context = []): bool
    {
        return $this->inner->supportsNormalization($data, $format, $context);
    }

    public function getSupportedTypes(?string $format): array
    {
        return $this->inner->getSupportedTypes($format);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);
namespace ApiPlatform\Symfony\Validator\State;
/**
 * Validates parameters using the Symfony validator.
 */
final class ParameterValidatorProvider implements ProviderInterface
{
    use ParameterParserTrait;
    public function __construct(
        private readonly ValidatorInterface $validator,
        private readonly ProviderInterface $decorated,
    ) {
    }
    public function provide(Operation $operation, array $uriVariables = [], array $context = []): object|array|null
    {
        if (!($request = $context['request'] ?? null) instanceof Request) {
            return $this->decorated->provide($operation, $uriVariables, $context);
        }
        $operation = $request->attributes->get('_api_operation') ?? $operation;
        if (!($operation->getQueryParameterValidationEnabled() ?? true)) {
            return $this->decorated->provide($operation, $uriVariables, $context);
        }
        $constraintViolationList = new ConstraintViolationList();
        $existingParameters = $operation->getParameters();
        $parameters = $existingParameters ? clone $existingParameters : new Parameters();
        if ($operation instanceof HttpOperation) {
            foreach ($operation->getUriVariables() ?? [] as $key => $uriVariable) {
                if ($uriVariable->getValue() instanceof ParameterNotFound) {
                    $uriVariable->setValue($uriVariables[$key] ?? new ParameterNotFound());
                }
                $parameters->add($key, $uriVariable->withKey($key));
            }
        }
        foreach ($parameters as $parameter) {
            if (!$constraints = $parameter->getConstraints()) {
                continue;
            }
            $value = $parameter->getValue();
            if ($value instanceof ParameterNotFound) {
                $value = null;
            }
            $violations = $this->validator->validate($value, $constraints);
            foreach ($violations as $violation) {
                $constraintViolationList->add(new ConstraintViolation(
                    $violation->getMessage(),
                    $violation->getMessageTemplate(),
                    $violation->getParameters(),
                    $violation->getRoot(),
                    $this->getProperty($parameter, $violation),
                    $violation->getInvalidValue(),
                    $violation->getPlural(),
                    $violation->getCode(),
                    $violation->getConstraint(),
                    $violation->getCause()
                ));
            }
        }
        if (0 !== \count($constraintViolationList)) {
            throw new ValidationException($constraintViolationList);
        }
        return $this->decorated->provide($operation, $uriVariables, $context);
    }
    // There's a `property` inside Parameter but it's used for hydra:search only as here we want the parameter name instead
    private function getProperty(Parameter $parameter, ConstraintViolationInterface $violation): string
    {
        $openApi = $parameter->getOpenApi();
        if (false === $openApi) {
            $openApi = null;
        }
        $key = $parameter->getKey();
        if (\is_array($openApi)) {
            foreach ($openApi as $oa) {
                if ('deepObject' === $oa->getStyle() && ($oa->getName() === $key || str_starts_with($oa->getName(), $key.'['))) {
                    return $key.$violation->getPropertyPath();
                }
            }
        } elseif ('deepObject' === $openApi?->getStyle() && $p = $violation->getPropertyPath()) {
            return $key.$p;
        }
        return $key;
    }

<?php

namespace App\Serializer;

use ApiPlatform\State\Pagination\PaginatorInterface;
use Symfony\Component\DependencyInjection\Attribute\AsDecorator;
use Symfony\Component\DependencyInjection\Attribute\AutowireDecorated;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\RequestStack;
use Symfony\Component\Serializer\Normalizer\NormalizerAwareInterface;
use Symfony\Component\Serializer\Normalizer\NormalizerInterface;

/**
 * Rewrites the JSON:API pagination links of a collection to use page[number] and page[size],
 * keeping every other query parameter (filters, sort, include) of the request.
 */
#[AsDecorator(decorates: 'api_platform.jsonapi.normalizer.collection')]
final class CollectionLinksNormalizer implements NormalizerInterface, NormalizerAwareInterface
{
    public function __construct(
        #[AutowireDecorated]
        private readonly NormalizerInterface $inner,
        private readonly RequestStack $requestStack,
    ) {
    }

    public function normalize(mixed $data, ?string $format = null, array $context = []): \ArrayObject|array|string|int|float|bool|null
    {
        $normalized = $this->inner->normalize($data, $format, $context);
        $request = $this->requestStack->getCurrentRequest();
        if (!$data instanceof PaginatorInterface || !is_array($normalized) || null === $request) {
            return $normalized;
        }

        $size = (int) $data->getItemsPerPage();
        $current = (int) $data->getCurrentPage();
        $last = (int) $data->getLastPage();
        $query = $request->query->all();

        $link = static fn (int $page): string => $request->getPathInfo().'?'.http_build_query(
            array_replace($query, ['page' => ['number' => $page, 'size' => $size]]),
            '',
            '&',
            \PHP_QUERY_RFC3986,
        );

        $links = [
            'self' => $link($current),
            'first' => $link(1),
            'last' => $link($last),
        ];
        if ($current > 1) {
            $links[x27prevx27] = $link(min($current - 1, $last));
        }
        if ($current < $last) {
            $links['next'] = $link($current + 1);
        }
        $normalized['links'] = $links;

        return $normalized;
    }

    public function setNormalizer(NormalizerInterface $normalizer): void
    {
        if ($this->inner instanceof NormalizerAwareInterface) {
            $this->inner->setNormalizer($normalizer);
        }
    }

    public function supportsNormalization(mixed $data, ?string $format = null, array $context = []): bool
    {
        return $this->inner->supportsNormalization($data, $format, $context);
    }

    public function getSupportedTypes(?string $format): array
    {
        return $this->inner->getSupportedTypes($format);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\OpenApi;

use ApiPlatform\OpenApi\Factory\OpenApiFactoryInterface;
use ApiPlatform\OpenApi\Model\Operation;
use ApiPlatform\OpenApi\Model\Parameter;
use ApiPlatform\OpenApi\Model\PathItem;
use ApiPlatform\OpenApi\Model\RequestBody;
use ApiPlatform\OpenApi\Model\Response;
use ApiPlatform\OpenApi\OpenApi;
use Symfony\Component\DependencyInjection\Attribute\AsDecorator;
use Symfony\Component\DependencyInjection\Attribute\AutowireDecorated;

/**
 * Documents what API Platform cannot derive from the resources: the request bodies, the
 * error responses of the write operations, and the CSV sales report.
 */
#[AsDecorator(decorates: 'api_platform.openapi.factory')]
final class BookshopOpenApiFactory implements OpenApiFactoryInterface
{
    private const JSON_API = 'application/vnd.api+json';

    public function __construct(
        #[AutowireDecorated]
        private readonly OpenApiFactoryInterface $inner,
    ) {
    }

    public function __invoke(array $context = []): OpenApi
    {
        $openApi = ($this->inner)($context);
        $paths = $openApi->getPaths();

        foreach (['/books', '/authors', '/purchases'] as $path) {
            $item = $paths->getPath($path);
            if (null !== $item?->getGet()) {
                $paths->addPath($path, $item->withGet($item->getGet()->withResponse(400, $this->errors('The request has an invalid query parameter.'))));
            }
        }

        foreach (['/purchases', '/purchases/{id}'] as $path) {
            $item = $paths->getPath($path);
            if (null !== $item?->getGet()) {
                $paths->addPath($path, $item->withGet($item->getGet()->withResponse(401, $this->errors('The Customer-Id header is missing or unknown.'))));
            }
        }

        $item = $paths->getPath('/purchases');
        $post = $item->getPost()
            ->withRequestBody($this->requestBody('Lines of the purchase.', $this->purchaseSchema()))
            ->withResponse(401, $this->errors('The Customer-Id header is missing or unknown.'))
            ->withResponse(402, $this->errors('The payment was declined.'))
            ->withResponse(409, $this->errors('Not enough stock for a book.'))
            ->withResponse(415, $this->errors('The Content-Type is not application/vnd.api+json.'))
            ->withResponse(502, $this->errors('The payment service failed or is unreachable.'));
        $paths->addPath('/purchases', $item->withPost($post));

        $item = $paths->getPath('/books/{id}');
        $patch = $item->getPatch()
            ->withRequestBody($this->requestBody('Attributes to change; only the ones sent are updated.', $this->bookSchema()))
            ->withResponse(204, new Response(description: 'The book is unpublished: nothing to return.'))
            ->withResponse(409, $this->errors('The id in the document does not match the id in the URL.'))
            ->withResponse(415, $this->errors('The Content-Type is not application/vnd.api+json.'));
        $paths->addPath('/books/{id}', $item->withPatch($patch));

        $paths->addPath('/reports/sales', new PathItem(get: $this->salesReport()));

        return $openApi->withPaths($paths);
    }

    private function salesReport(): Operation
    {
        return new Operation(
            operationId: 'getSalesReport',
            tags: ['Reports'],
            summary: 'Sales report as CSV',
            parameters: [
                new Parameter(name: 'from', in: 'query', description: 'First day included (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC).', required: true, schema: ['type' => 'string', 'format' => 'date']),
                new Parameter(name: 'to', in: 'query', description: 'Last day included (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC).', required: true, schema: ['type' => 'string', 'format' => 'date']),
            ],
            responses: [

<?php

namespace App\OpenApi;

use ApiPlatform\OpenApi\Factory\OpenApiFactoryInterface;
use ApiPlatform\OpenApi\Model\Operation;
use ApiPlatform\OpenApi\Model\Parameter;
use ApiPlatform\OpenApi\Model\PathItem;
use ApiPlatform\OpenApi\Model\RequestBody;
use ApiPlatform\OpenApi\Model\Response;
use ApiPlatform\OpenApi\OpenApi;
use Symfony\Component\DependencyInjection\Attribute\AsDecorator;
use Symfony\Component\DependencyInjection\Attribute\AutowireDecorated;

/**
 * Documents what API Platform cannot derive from the resources: the request bodies, the
 * error responses of the write operations, and the CSV sales report.
 */
#[AsDecorator(decorates: 'api_platform.openapi.factory')]
final class BookshopOpenApiFactory implements OpenApiFactoryInterface
{
    private const JSON_API = 'application/vnd.api+json';

    public function __construct(
        #[AutowireDecorated]
        private readonly OpenApiFactoryInterface $inner,
    ) {
    }

    public function __invoke(array $context = []): OpenApi
    {
        $openApi = ($this->inner)($context);
        $paths = $openApi->getPaths();

        foreach (['/books', '/authors', '/purchases'] as $path) {
            $item = $paths->getPath($path);
            if (null !== $item?->getGet()) {
                $paths->addPath($path, $item->withGet($item->getGet()->withResponse(400, $this->errors('The request has an invalid query parameter.'))));
            }
        }

        foreach (['/purchases', '/purchases/{id}'] as $path) {
            $item = $paths->getPath($path);
            if (null !== $item?->getGet()) {
                $paths->addPath($path, $item->withGet($item->getGet()->withResponse(401, $this->errors('The Customer-Id header is missing or unknown.'))));
            }
        }

        $item = $paths->getPath('/purchases');
        $post = $item->getPost()
            ->withRequestBody($this->requestBody('Lines of the purchase.', $this->purchaseSchema()))
            ->withResponse(401, $this->errors('The Customer-Id header is missing or unknown.'))
            ->withResponse(402, $this->errors('The payment was declined.'))
            ->withResponse(409, $this->errors('Not enough stock for a book.'))
            ->withResponse(415, $this->errors('The Content-Type is not application/vnd.api+json.'))
            ->withResponse(502, $this->errors('The payment service failed or is unreachable.'));
        $paths->addPath('/purchases', $item->withPost($post));

        $item = $paths->getPath('/books/{id}');
        $patch = $item->getPatch()
            ->withRequestBody($this->requestBody('Attributes to change; only the ones sent are updated.', $this->bookSchema()))
            ->withResponse(204, new Response(description: 'The book is unpublished: nothing to return.'))
            ->withResponse(409, $this->errors('The id in the document does not match the id in the URL.'))
            ->withResponse(415, $this->errors('The Content-Type is not application/vnd.api+json.'));
        $paths->addPath('/books/{id}', $item->withPatch($patch));

        $paths->addPath('/reports/sales', new PathItem(get: $this->salesReport()));

        return $openApi->withPaths($paths);
    }

    private function salesReport(): Operation
    {
        return new Operation(
            operationId: 'getSalesReport',
            tags: ['Reports'],
            summary: 'Sales report as CSV',
            parameters: [
                new Parameter(name: 'from', in: 'query', description: 'First day included (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC).', required: true, schema: ['type' => 'string', 'format' => 'date']),
                new Parameter(name: 'to', in: 'query', description: 'Last day included (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC).', required: true, schema: ['type' => 'string', 'format' => 'date']),
            ],
            responses: [
                '200' => new Response(
                    description: 'CSV file with the columns title, quantity and revenueCents, one line per book sold, by revenue.',
                    content: new \ArrayObject(['text/csv' => ['schema' => ['type' => 'string']]]),
                ),
                '400' => $this->errors('The from or to date is missing, malformed, or from is after to.'),
            ],
        );
    }

    private function requestBody(string $description, array $attributesSchema): RequestBody
    {
        return new RequestBody(
            description: $description,
            content: new \ArrayObject([self::JSON_API => ['schema' => $attributesSchema]]),
            required: true,
        );
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private function purchaseSchema(): array
    {
        return [
            'type' => 'object',
            'required' => ['data'],
            'properties' => [
                'data' => [
                    'type' => 'object',
                    'required' => ['type', 'attributes'],
                    'properties' => [
                        'type' => ['type' => 'string', 'enum' => ['purchases']],
                        'attributes' => [
                            'type' => 'object',
                            'required' => ['lines'],
                            'properties' => [
                                'lines' => [
                                    'type' => 'array',
                                    'minItems' => 1,
                                    'items' => [
                                        'type' => 'object',
                                        'required' => ['bookId', 'quantity'],
                                        'properties' => [
                                            'bookId' => ['type' => 'integer', 'minimum' => 1],
                                            'quantity' => ['type' => 'integer', 'minimum' => 1],
                                        ],
                                    ],
                                ],
                            ],
                        ],
                    ],
                ],
            ],
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private function bookSchema(): array
    {
        return [
            'type' => 'object',
            'required' => ['data'],
            'properties' => [
                'data' => [
                    'type' => 'object',
                    'required' => ['type', 'id', 'attributes'],
                    'properties' => [
                        'type' => ['type' => 'string', 'enum' => ['books']],
                        'id' => ['type' => 'string'],
                        'attributes' => [
                            'type' => 'object',
                            'properties' => [
                                'title' => ['type' => 'string', 'minLength' => 1],
                                'priceCents' => ['type' => 'integer', 'minimum' => 0],
                                'stock' => ['type' => 'integer', 'minimum' => 0],
                            ],
                        ],
                    ],
                ],
            ],
        ];
    }

    private function errors(string $description): Response
    {
        return new Response(
            description: $description,
            content: new \ArrayObject([self::JSON_API => ['schema' => [
                'type' => 'object',
                'required' => ['errors'],
                'properties' => [
                    'errors' => [
                        'type' => 'array',
                        'items' => [
                            'type' => 'object',
                            'required' => ['status', 'title', 'detail'],
                            'properties' => [
                                'status' => ['type' => 'string'],
                                'title' => ['type' => 'string'],
                                'detail' => ['type' => 'string'],
                                'source' => ['type' => 'object'],
                            ],
                        ],
                    ],
                ],
            ]]]),
        );
    }
}

content.text:
The bookshop API is built and runs with `./start.sh`. I tested it over HTTP against the real database and the payment service, then stopped it and restored the table data.

**What's there**
- **Resources** (`src/ApiResource`): books, authors and purchases, with JSON:API output from API Platform 5. The schema is unchanged; all queries are raw SQL through DBAL.
- **Reads**: providers in `src/State`. A shared parser (`src/Http/QueryParser.php`) enforces the 400 rules for `include`, `sort`, `page` and `filter`.
- **Writes**: PATCH and POST purchases use processors that read the raw JSON:API body, so the 415, 409, 422, 402, 409 and 502 cases are explicit.
- **Purchases**: the `Customer-Id` check runs before routing-dependent logic and before any validation. Stock is locked with `FOR UPDATE` before the payment call, so a failed payment rolls back cleanly.
- **Report**: `GET /reports/sales` is a plain controller, CSV with RFC 4180 quoting.
- **Errors**: one listener renders every error as a JSON:API error document.
- **OpenAPI**: served at `/openapi.json` as 3.0.0, including the report, request bodies and the extra error responses.

**Verified**
- Every endpoint's happy path and its listed error cases, including payment declined (402) and payment 500 (502).
- Aggregates and combined filters match SQL.
- No PHP warnings or deprecations in the server log.

**Choices you may want to review**
- Pagination links are path-only (`/books?page[number]=2&page[size]=10&…`), matching the `links.self` form in the spec. A page past the end gets `prev` pointing at the last real page.
- The report's `Content-Type` is `text/csv; charset=UTF-8`, which is Symfony's default for text types. It's the same media type as `text/csv`.
- PATCH accepts a document without `data.id` rather than rejecting it, since the spec doesn't say.
- Items that aren't in the database or are unpublished return 422 on the `bookId` pointer. Non-integer ids are rejected rather than coerced.
- The JSON:API `_id` attribute appears on each resource because of how the serializer handles `id`. The spec allows extra attributes, so I left it.
- The payment unreachable branch (connection refused or timeout) isn't exercised live; I tested the 500 branch.

**Changes outside the code**
- `.env`: `DATABASE_URL` now points at the eval DSN, and `DEFAULT_URI` is `http://localhost:8089`.
- Added `symfony/http-client` (payment calls) and `api-platform/json-api` (the JSON:API format needs it).
- `start.sh` runs `php -S 0.0.0.0:8089` in the foreground, so killing that process stops the API.

**Database state**
- Table rows are back to the snapshot exactly. The test purchases and PATCH changes were reverted.
- The `eval_rw` role can't reset sequences, so `purchase_id_seq` is at 9 and `purchase_line_id_seq` at 14. The next purchase will get id 10.

The API is stopped.
